Up in the Upper Town the Lamp Office and the academy, that's where the people live who don't get wet feet. And out there the stilt village, you only go there if the old folk let you."

"If you want to find anything here, you have to know the city first. All six corners."
„Zu spät. Die Streife ist vor einer Stun: "Too late. The patrol left an hour ago." Hale pulls on her gloves. "I told you nothing. And I didn't see you. Go, before I change my mind."
„Über Bracks Hafensteg am Bojenhafen. Do: "Over Brack's harbour jetty at the Buoy Harbour. His boat lies there, but first the Grey Scouts and the weather have to play along. Down in the rock there are vaults, and in there it's worse than the moor." She counts on her fingers. "Take tonic. And if you want Brandt in court: Hale, Marlowe and Starling. Without all three nobody will believe you."
„… und der Neue aus Kettlegate? Der hält:
"… and the new one from Kettlegate? He won't last three weeks."
"The seamstress lasted four."
"She didn't ask so many questions either."

When they notice you, they talk about peat prices.
